en: Illustrated postcard showing a busy street scene in front of an ornately decorated multi‑storey building with green shutters, shopfronts on the ground floor and a sign reading "DREI MOHREN". Well‑dressed pedestrians in early 20th‑century fashion walk along the street. Below the illustration, printed text identifies the location as Karlsbad, Goethehaus on Alte Wiese. The lower margin also contains a logo and the words "OÖ LANDES-KULTUR GMBH".
